messages:
Ethan R (Sales): Heads-up: prospect 'AtlasPay' asked for a compact assurance bundle before we finalize the POC quote. They want SOC2 summary, ISO cert, a signed pen-test attestation, and a short note on how Dedicated would change price/ETA. Need to reply by COB.

Nina V (Solutions): I can assemble the bundle. Typical lightweight pack: SOC2 summary (pdf), ISO27001 certificate, pen-test attestation template (signed after recipient confirmed), short ops note for Dedicated (cost + provisioning ETA), and sanitized staging network diagram.

Priya S (Security): We have a one-page pen-test attestation template. We need the customer's legal "TO:" line to populate. We can redact internal IPs/keys. Turnaround: signed within 48 hours after recipient confirmed.

Oliver G (Legal): Legal will sign the attestation as 'Redwood Inference, Inc. Legal Counsel on behalf of Security'. Please provide the recipient legal entity name and acknowledgement that they accept our template. I'll sign within 48 hours after that.

Mark T (Infra): Dedicated uplift estimate for a small 2-GPU pool: $7,500/month, one-time setup $4,200. Provisioning lead time ~6 business days after PO. If they remain on hosted, no infra changes. We also need to schedule an external scan window; prefer Mon 09:00-13:00 UTC.

Ethan R (Sales): Can someone create a read-only dataroom link with the draft bundle so I can send it to AtlasPay? Also include the Dedicated cost/ETA text. They want an answer today.

DataroomBot: Assurance workspace created: https://dataroom.redwood/assurance/ATLASPAY-5612345678 (view-only). Uploaded: soc2-summary.pdf, iso27001-cert.pdf, pen-test-template.docx (unsigned), dedicated-cost-note.txt

Priya S (Security): Added a short redaction policy note in the dataroom. Once AtlasPay gives the TO: line I'll sign the attestation within ~48h.

Oliver G (Legal): Confirmed. Send me the recipient name and I'll prepare and sign.

Mark T (Infra): Confirmed Dedicated numbers above. Scan window preference: Mon 09:00-13:00 UTC.

Ethan R (Sales): Thanks all. I'll reply to AtlasPay with the dataroom link, state that the signed pen-test attestation will be delivered within 48 hours after they confirm the recipient TO: line, and include Dedicated pricing/lead time. Will update thread with their response. :pray:
